question_text: A 52-year-old woman presents to her primary care physician for her annual checkup. She lost her job 6 months ago and since then she has been feeling worthless because nobody wants to hire her. She also says that she is finding it difficult to concentrate, which is exacerbated by the fact that she has lost interest in activities that she used to love such as doing puzzles and working in the garden. She says that she is sleeping over 10 hours every day because she says it is difficult to find the energy to get up in the morning. She denies having any thoughts about suicide. Which of the following neurotransmitter profiles would most likely be seen in this patient?
